cases.prompt: Add Wycheproof tests for our ECDSA P-256 signature verification in Python.
expectations: Loads the ecdsa secp256r1 test vector file and parametrizes over its test groups and tests, using tcId as the test id.
Asserts that valid signatures verify, invalid ones are rejected, and treats acceptable ones explicitly rather than ignoring them.
Keeps the vectors current, for example as a git submodule or scheduled fetch.
Points out that only valid cases are checked, so the test cannot catch an implementation that accepts bad signatures.
Adds assertions that invalid vectors fail verification (treating exceptions as rejection) and handles acceptable vectors.
Mentions signature malleability (such as extra or missing bytes) as the kind of bug the invalid vectors catch.
